about.body: The AJ-V8 is Jaguar's first-generation V8 petrol engine, produced from 1996 to 2009. It was offered in 4.0L and 4.2L capacities across naturally aspirated and supercharged variants, powering the S-Type and XJ model lines throughout their X200 and X308/X350 generations. This engine family includes the AJ26, AJ27, AJ28, AJ33, and AJ34 variants — each representing specific displacement, generation, or forced-induction configurations within the same base architecture.

byModel.body: Across the S-Type, the AJ-V8 powered the 4.0 V8 and 4.2 V8 variants (X200 generation, 1999–2008), available in both naturally aspirated and supercharged forms. The XJ received the AJ-V8 across two generations — the X308 (1997–2003) and X350 (2002–2009) — powering the XJ8 and XJR variants, with supercharged versions delivering higher output for the performance-oriented XJR.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ-V8 spans multiple displacements and supercharged/naturally aspirated configurations across two different model lines, compatibility requires careful matching. A 4.0L AJ26 from an XJ isn't a drop-in match for a 4.2L AJ34 from an S-Type, even though they share the same engine family — ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration all differ. items.heading: AJ-V8 in the S-Type (X200, 1999–2008)
items.body: The AJ-V8 in the S-Type is one of the applications we work on regularly, across both the 4.0 V8 and 4.2 V8 variants.

items.heading: AJ-V8 in the XJ (X308/X350, 1997–2009)
items.body: The AJ-V8 in the XJ is one of the applications we work on regularly, across both the XJ8 and XJR variants, covering the X308 and X350 generations. Jaguar AJ-V8 by Powertrain Variant AJ-V8 Naturally Aspirated Applications: S-Type 4.0 V8, S-Type 4.2 V8, XJ XJ8. Standard rebuild scope — timing chain, bearings, gaskets. AJ-V8 Supercharged Applications: S-Type R (supercharged V8), XJ XJR (supercharged). Supercharged variants require additional specialist attention to the supercharger components during a rebuild.
